summary: Tested pqc.market launcher backend (metadata, trade-local, launches) and frontend launch page. All 6 pytest tests pass against real pump.fun IPFS + PumpPortal upstreams. Frontend renders cleanly with all required data-testids, correct gating when no Phantom extension is present, no console errors or Buffer polyfill issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/metadata: image file is fully buffered into memory before size check; the 10MB cap is enforced after read. Acceptable but consider streaming/aborting early on large uploads to avoid memory spikes.
server.py: TradeRequest.tokenMetadata is a free-form dict with manual key check; a nested Pydantic model would give 422 details automatically.
server.py: /api/launches uses update_one upsert but response includes mongodb _id implicitly via dict(doc); the explicit doc.pop('_id', None) is correct — kept.
seed_data_creation: Created one test launch doc with mint 'TEST_MINT_AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA' (upsert, no duplicates). Safe to leave or clean via mint prefix TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: POST /api/metadata (multipart), POST /api/trade-local (returns octet-stream), POST /api/launches (attaches WOTS attestation chains=67, w=16), GET /api/launches. Real on-chain signing can't be automated (needs funded Phantom extension). Frontend wallet-button reads 'Get Phantom' in headless Chromium (no extension) and submit button disabled with 'Connect Phantom to launch'. pump.fun IPFS and PumpPortal are reachable from this environment.
